input.quote: Commerce One warrants that the Software and MarketSite.net Service will perform in substantial accordance with the Documentation, and the media on which the Software is distributed will be free from defects in materials and workmanship under normal use, for a period of sixty (60) days from the Effective Date, but in no event not later than December 31, 1999 (the \"Warranty Period\")
input.rationale: Section 7.3 gives a conformance-to-Documentation warranty for the Software and the MarketSite.net Service, and Section 7.3/7.4 add a malicious-code and Y2K warranty, with correction, replacement and (if correction is not possible) termination plus refund of prepaid fees as remedies. The remedy limb therefore meets the fallback (repair/replacement and refund), but the duration does not: the Warranty Period is only sixty (60) days and is further truncated by a hard December 31, 1999 outside date, so the software conformance warranty falls short of the 90-day fallback floor and the service warranty could be cut below 30 days. We therefore extended the period to ninety (90) days and deleted the outside date, leaving the existing remedies and the cross-reference to the defined \"Warranty Period\" in Sections 7.3 and 11.2 intact. We did not press the preferred position (12 months software, express professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, compliance with laws), which we note but do not require here.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
mappings.quote: Commerce One shall take all commercially reasonable efforts to correct the Software and MarketSite.net Service, or if correction of the Software and MarketSite.net Service is reasonably not possible, replace such Software and MarketSite.net Service free of charge.
Corio has the right to terminate this Agreement and receive a refund of all prepaid fees.
